result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): The two pages are very close. Both use a soft dark background with off-white body text at about 16px with clear line spacing, and both put the uptime figures in a right-aligned monospace column. A has slightly brighter percentages and a cleaner date-then-title order for incidents. B's green status dots and banner add helpful meaning, but its grayer percentages are a little dimmer. Neither one is clearly better. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): The two pages are close to identical: both have comfortable off-white text on a near-black background, right-aligned monospace uptime figures, and incident cards that keep the date, title and body apart. A wins narrowly because its bolder headings and status line give a clearer split between text levels. B's medium-weight headings are a bit softer, though B's brighter percentages are slightly easier to read than A's dim gray ones.
